notes.title: Update 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Update 1.0.4 is here, with a mix of bug fixes and small improvements to make your experience smoother as always.

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added new Throwing mechanic (hold the throw button to launch an item or monster farther).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267082/eeebf0311092a9fc35d96a167b0411e907371403.gif[/img]
[*] Added new opportunities to gain reputation experience points when completing missions, hatching a monster, winning a race or a battle dance, giving a monster up for adoption, and gaining gacha.
[*] Increased the rate of new customer arrivals in late game.
[/list]
[h3]Fixed Issues[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with players holding items over their heads while crouching in multiplayer.
[*] Fixed hat issues for the Vespera Monster.
[*] Fixed Door Furniture not reverting to its normal material color in multiplayer.
[*] Fixed broken Monster Happiness missions that were unlocking before the monster was actually happy.
[*] Added a security message when attempting (and failing) to join a multiplayer session with players using a different version of Monster Care Simulator.
[*] Several other issues have been addressed to improve the gameplay experience.
[/list]

✨ Hey…
If you had fun playing, dropping us a little review on Steam would help a ton, and seriously brighten our day. 💖

notes.title: Update 0.6 – Care, Treatments & Missions
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]
We’re thrilled to bring you Update 0.6, packed with new healing mechanics, status effects, and mission features to make your time in the monster care center even more engaging!

[h2]🧬 New Status Effect: Poisoned![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267082/88bd436cbf7ec544074a8c67aa0fcbd7deda5d42.gif[/img]

Poisoned monsters are here!
You’ll now be able to treat this condition through a brand-new interactive mini-game using antivenom. Hold to extract poison, watch it move across the monster’s body, and enjoy satisfying feedback like changing facial expressions and custom particles.

[h2]🧼 Expanded Treatment System[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267082/94673bcafa0c800add26ea6c4f4030a53274d622.gif[/img]

All treatment types: Dirt, Injury, Fire, Ice, and Poison — now include multiple levels of complexity, each with unique tools, sequences, and visual feedback.
Your center will now face everything from sticky tar to monsters frozen in giant ice blocks!

[h2]📋 New Mission System[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267082/faebdb19473e2b8ff48212a3feb9d9b92e4a806e.png[/img]
To add more structure to your sessions, we’ve introduced a mission system:
[list]
[*] Clients may now request specific tasks during analysis.
[*] You can track and manage missions from the tablet.
[*] Switch between active missions, or decline them if you're already busy!
[/list]
Missions include various goals, improving monster happiness, customizing appearances, completing healing tasks, or treadmill distance challenges.

[h2]📱 New Tablet Tab: Monster in care[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267082/7f4c0eb20105b5fbcae8900c7faab7d4a25ec5e9.png[/img]
A brand new "Monsters" tab has been added to your tablet!
Here, you can:
[list]
[*] View all monsters currently in your center.
[*] Check their treatment progress at a glance.
[*] See which tasks are left to complete for each one.
[/list]
This makes managing your daily care routine clearer and more satisfying than ever!

[h2]🛠️ New Tools & Visuals[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267082/6cb4ce7bf46a955b4bbd57694bdd3347a5cb4347.gif[/img]

To support all these new treatment levels, we’ve added a bunch of new tools and effects:
Extractors, dryers, extinguishers, upgraded bandages, and more, all with unique particles and visual feedback to make healing even more fun!

[h2]🐞 Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where monsters could teleport from the first floor to the ground floor unexpectedly.
[*] Resolved a bug where players could select an item while carrying a cardboard box, causing inconsistent behavior.
[*] Fixed an issue where paintings placed near stairwell walls could get stuck and become unremovable
[/list]

[h3]Psst… hey! 🐾[/h3]
If you’d like to help out the kind devs (well… we think we’re kind), leaving a little review really helps us a ton!
And don’t hesitate to stop by and say hi on our Discord, we love hearing from you!

[url=https://discord.gg/wcYgWezmPb][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267082/5ab554b21a5edd50858023b675ba8c52bd56f9fd.png[/img][/url]

Monster hugs to all of you! 💚👾

notes.title: Update 0.4
notes.notes:
[h1]Big Update 0.4 is here![/h1]
This is our biggest one yet, packed with key improvements to storage, staff behavior, and save management. Let’s break it down!

[h2]Monster Care 0.4 – Core Systems & Quality of Life[/h2]

[h3]Inventory & Storage Overhaul[/h3]
• Items now stack! Up to 99 per shelf slot and 5 per inventory slot.
• Resource usage is now more intuitive.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267082/e0a8c02c27d68e7c9f66922d1b59ed91a451e6aa.gif[/img]

[h3]New Employee Behavior[/h3]
• Employees now require healing resources and will ask you when they run out.
• Restock shelves or hand them the item directly to keep treatments running smoothly.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267082/bd128790e111da965409b4e2dd9f30167e91e643.gif[/img]

[h3]No More Money Deadlocks[/h3]
• Sell used items at the second-hand shop to earn some cash back.
• Customers now pick up monsters after a few days, even if not fully healed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267082/445dc8ab17b29a68ab51f3850c95c763c2074b53.png[/img]

[h3]Broom Upgrade[/h3]
• The broom now has its own quick-access slot, just press "B" to clean up anytime!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267082/fb3d582b229fb01e2f4d4dc40138b3c1c200193e.png[/img]

[h3]Multiple Save Slots[/h3]
• Create, load or delete up to 4 save files.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267082/35af82b8e98901aacf795e4a5849b15c6add9a76.png[/img]

[h3]Bug Fixes & Polish[/h3]
• Fixed collision issues (stairs, garden wall, cashier stuck bugs).
• Sick monsters are no longer placed in upper-floor beds.
• Fixed color issues in the center and onboarding zones.
• Hatching particles no longer get stuck.
• Hat placement corrected on some monsters.
• Improved Russian localization.
• Reputation bug fixed for monsters in beds.
• Fixed furniture placement issues (paintings, frames).

Psst, a little message from the devs:
If you can drop a quick review on Steam, it really helps make the game more visible. Thank you so much for your support! 💖

We can’t wait to show you what’s coming next!

[*] Introduced a brand-new petting system: find your monster’s sweet spots to boost happiness faster — and save your wrist!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267082/09de04a1b9f903e1f87336c079b0900950ae3d3b.gif[/img]
[*] Cashiers now prioritize placing monsters into available stations before defaulting to the garden
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267082/5472c022d37e1da663132420971010881f31fd71.gif[/img]
[*] Full controller support is now fully functional in both the Improvement and Hiring menus
[*] Added a camera stick sensitivity setting for better control
[/list]

[h3]🩹 Bug Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the ukulele or monster dancing behaviors could break under certain conditions
[*] Resolved a bug causing monsters to disappear or teleport to the upper floor before it's unlocked
[*] Added a new mission requiring players to buy Fun Pack 1 before purchasing the bed
[*] Repositioned house walls to fix misalignment across center upgrades
[*] Fixed a display bug where the monster capacity text wouldn’t update after a center upgrade
[*] Prevented employees from stealing monsters currently being treated by the player
[*] Fixed a bug allowing players to interrupt employee treatments and steal monsters, which caused various issues
[*] Resolved a custom resolution bug that reset settings when switching between menus and gameplay
[*] Fixed an issue allowing eggs to hatch even when the hatcher was full; also patched affected save files
[*] Added extra safety checks to prevent furniture from getting stuck after center upgrades
[*] Updated the default prices for monster slot purchases
[/list]


✨💌 Pssst… tiny favor time!
If you’re enjoying the game, leaving a quick review on Steam helps us a lot, like, really a lot.
Plus, it makes us do a little happy wiggle behind the scenes 🐾

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267082/faf385ad9de03536c4993b4e515b341b398ef6f9.gif[/img]
